title: Comparative Simulations of Conformational Flexibility during Radical Transport in Ribonucleotide Reductase.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学和QM/MM模拟研究核糖核苷酸还原酶中自由基转运相关的构象柔性，属于蛋白质构象采样与计算模拟课题，方法创新且对象、问题、方法三者齐备。
abstract: Ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) is an essential enzyme that converts ribonucleotides to deoxyribonucleotides, utilizing a  approximately 32 A chain of proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) reactions spanning two protein subunits to generate a catalytic cysteine radical. Two cryogenic electron microscopy structures of the active complex of E. coli RNR are currently available. One structure was trapped in the preturnover state, prior to radical translocation, and the other structure was trapped in the midturnover state, with the radical in the active site. Herein, we use molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the differences in hydrogen-bonding interactions and conformational motions between the preturnover and midturnover states. Our simulations show that Y731, an interfacial tyrosine that participates in the PCET pathway, samples multiple conformations in both states, allowing it to participate in forward and reverse PCET between subunits. We also observe interfacial water channels between the protein subunits in both states. Moreover, our simulations show that E623, which is near Y730 in the preturnover structure and was shown by previous simulations to mediate PCET between Y731 and Y730, can also sample conformations distal to Y730 in the preturnover state, similar to its position in the midturnover structure. Our mixed quantum mechanical/molecular mechanical free energy simulations indicate that forward radical transfer from Y731 to Y730 is thermodynamically favorable with a reasonable free energy barrier, even in the absence of mediation by E623. These results provide insights into the critical role of conformational motions and flexibility in regulating PCET reactions at and near the protein subunit interface of RNR.
abstract_zh: 核糖核苷酸还原酶（RNR）是一种必需酶，负责将核糖核苷酸转化为脱氧核糖核苷酸，利用约32 Å长的质子耦合电子转移（PCET）反应链跨越两个蛋白质亚基，以生成催化性半胱氨酸自由基。目前已有两种大肠杆菌RNR活性复合物的冷冻电镜结构。一种结构被捕获在预周转状态，即自由基转位之前；另一种结构被捕获在周转中间状态，此时自由基位于活性位点。本文中，我们使用分子动力学模拟来研究预周转状态与周转中间状态之间氢键相互作用和构象运动的差异。我们的模拟表明，Y731（一种参与PCET途径的界面酪氨酸）在两种状态下均采样多种构象，使其能够参与亚基间的正向和反向PCET。我们还观察到两种状态下蛋白质亚基之间的界面水通道。此外，我们的模拟显示，E623（在预周转结构中靠近Y730，且先前模拟表明其介导Y731与Y730之间的PCET）在预周转状态下也能采样远离Y730的构象，类似于其在周转中间结构中的位置。我们的混合量子力学/分子力学自由能模拟表明，从Y731到Y730的正向自由基转移在热力学上是有利的，且具有合理的自由能势垒，即使在缺乏E623介导的情况下也是如此。这些结果揭示了构象运动和灵活性在调控RNR蛋白质亚基界面及其附近PCET反应中的关键作用。
